copy.notes: Requested. Renders the workspace theme copy: every asset URL sits under cdn.hstatic.net/themes/200001207485/1001512581/ and the body is the workspace loomline (ll-*) index markup, clearly different from production. No auth wall, no captcha, no redirect. Page routes honour the copy as well (/pages/about-us?themeid=1001512581 renders with og:image under .../1001512581/). httpStatus 200 is inferred from a successful render: the fetch layer reports a status code only on failure, where it reports the exact code (e.g. 404). Hazard: an unknown themeid (e.g. 999999999) silently renders production 1001510509 with HTTP 200, so a capture must be asserted by the theme id appearing in the cdn.hstatic.net/themes/<org>/<themeid>/ asset URLs. Hazard: an unknown view silently falls back to the parent template with no error. Every surfaces[] and views[] URL in this file was requested at least once on 2026-09-11.

live.notes: Requested. themeid=-1 is live production: asset URLs sit under cdn.hstatic.net/themes/200001207485/1001510509/ and the render matches https://phukienmaymoc.com/ in structure. No auth required. httpStatus 200 inferred from a successful render (the fetch layer reports status only on failure). Used to verify the page.* alternates that the copy theme does not contain (see unresolved[]).

unresolved.name: contact
unresolved.reason: templates/page.contact.liquid has no owning page record: sitemap_pages_1.xml lists only chinh-sach-bao-mat, about-us, dieu-khoan-dich-vu, frontpage, chinh-sach-doi-tra and lien-he, and /pages/contact returns HTTP 404. The copy theme 1001512581 does not contain the template: https://phukienmaymoc.com/pages/lien-he?themeid=1001512581&view=contact silently falls back to page.liquid (identical body to /pages/lien-he, none of the template's markers such as 'Always Ready To Be Different' appear). The live theme does render it: https://phukienmaymoc.com/pages/lien-he?themeid=-1&view=contact was requested and the marker is present. Capturable only after the copy is synced.

unresolved.name: member
unresolved.reason: templates/customers[account].member.liquid is auth-gated. Both https://phukienmaymoc.com/account?themeid=1001512581 and https://phukienmaymoc.com/account?themeid=1001512581&view=member resolve to https://phukienmaymoc.com/auth/200001207485/sign-in?urlredirect=... (Haravan hosted sign-in, title 'Haravan - Checkouts'), so the account view cannot be captured anonymously. The sibling customers[*] templates belong to the /account/login, /account/register, /account/addresses and /account/orders routes and are gated the same way.
